instruction: Disable the automatic screen dimming feature on my Ubuntu desktop to keep the screen brightness constant.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
